candidates.title: Account Existing Pet Sync Check
candidates.change: Inserts a explicit cloud sync status badge and pet recovery check component directly on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, leading to account confusion.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Sync Companion
sign_in.hint: Your existing pet profiles and items will automatically restore.

guard.reason: The sign-in cloud save badge and hint enhance account sync without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high volume of support tickets (8) on sign-in issues, but requires new screen UI.

candidates.title: Adoption Preview Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a split view layout with instant live pet previews alongside option selection.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a steep drop (60.9% conversion) and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s).

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Companion
pick_friend.hint: Select options to watch your pet react live.

guard.reason: The split-view redesign preserves the core job of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the largest drop-off step (adoption at 60.9%) with long completion times.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Error Rescue Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the photo upload screen into a two-column design featuring photo quality guidelines and immediate preset fallbacks.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures and distorted pet visuals.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo for Custom Generation
upload_photos.hint: Use bright lighting and clear forward-facing photos for best results.

guard.reason: The two-column photo upload layout preserves custom photo generation functionality.

candidates.score_note: Fixes custom photo generation failures reported in support emails, but involves complex flow.

candidates.title: Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Reorders the journey so pet selection occurs before account registration, allowing users to fall in love with their pet first.
candidates.why: Sign in currently happens right after path choice, causing early dropoff before users experience pet customization.

choose_path.hint: Choose your path to pick your companion first.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring auth until after value delivery is a proven UX pattern to boost top-of-funnel retention.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Diagnostics Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen explaining desktop engine startup and tray icon location.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to launch post-setup.

waiting.hint: Your pet will launch directly onto your desktop. Check system tray if minimized.

guard.reason: Adding diagnostic hints on the waiting screen retains the screen's core function and adheres to all rules.

candidates.score_note: Low effort fix addressing 3 support emails regarding desktop placement issues.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Stage Breakdown
candidates.change: Replaces the generic waiting message with stage-by-stage progress breakdown and estimated completion timer.
candidates.why: Home wait step shows very long mean duration (2336s) causing users to abandon during pet rendering.

guard.reason: Progress breakdowns and time estimates for real rendering delays are allowed under Rule 5 and maintain the waiting screen's job.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait times (2336s) at home step using low-cost progress feedback.

candidates.title: Pet Control Cards Quick Overview
candidates.change: Reconfigures home intro screen into a grid layout showcasing visual control cards for moving, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion after onboarding on how to interact with or hide their desktop pet.

components.text: Drag pet to move | Right click to hide or call

candidates.title: First-Day Accessory Unlock Banner
candidates.change: Adds a reward banner and play button on home intro to incentivize immediate onboarding completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding finish rate is only 19.5%, needing immediate motivation at the final screen.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready + Free Starter Kit Unlocked!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Kit' and 'Free Starter Accessory', violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras, gifts, or prices.

candidates.title: Certificate Name Auto-Save Indicator
candidates.change: Adds an active verification badge and auto-save feedback when typing pet name on the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption flow median duration is high (89s median / 1017s mean) partly due to uncertainty during certificate completion.

adoption_certificate.hint: Certificate name automatically saved to desktop pet tag.

guard.reason: The auto-save tag registration badge retains the official adoption certificate functionality.

candidates.score_note: Quick feedback polish to reduce certificate step hesitation during adoption.

candidates.title: Story Path Persona Selection Guidance
candidates.change: Clarifies path options on the story screen with descriptive guidance on ready-made vs photo-based pet paths.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation when deciding how to start.

story.body: Pick Quick Start for preset companion pets or Custom Creator to generate a pet from photos.
story.hint: You can add more pets anytime after setup.

guard.reason: Replacing the story content with path selection guidance removes the story screen's required job of introducing the pet.
